name: Org Workspace
description: Clones the repos of a GitHub org into sibling /workspaces folders and keeps a multi-root .code-workspace file up to date.

org.description: GitHub org (or user) to clone from. Empty means the owner of this project's origin remote.

repos.description: Comma-separated repos to clone, e.g. "typescript,action". When set, autoDiscover is ignored.

autoDiscover.description: Clone the org's repos automatically. "true" means public and private, no forks, no archived. "false" clones nothing. A list such as "public,fork" picks the categories: public, private, internal, fork, archived.

exclude.description: Comma-separated repos to skip, whether they come from repos or autoDiscover.

generateCodeWorkspace.description: Create or update the .code-workspace file. Existing folder names and settings are kept.

codeWorkspaceName.description: Name of the .code-workspace file, in the project's root folder. Empty means <org>.code-workspace.
